git show af290a4afbfa07a2de2e29dc08e768adc7fea166:lib/capability-profiles.json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
groups=d['groups']
# find which group has preflight
pf=[g for g,tools in groups.items() if any('preflight.py' in str(t) for t in tools)]
print('groups w/ preflight:', pf)
for p,pv in d['profiles'].items():
    print(p, pv.get('groups'))
"
